description: Search FINRA BrokerCheck brokers and firms, or fetch full profiles and disclosures by CRD.

crdNumbers.description: CRD numbers or BrokerCheck profile URLs to fetch (modes=brokerProfiles, firmProfiles). Up to 1,000 entries; duplicates are removed.
crdNumbers.title: CRDs or profile URLs

disclosuresOnly.description: Only emit brokers or firms with at least one broker-dealer or investment-adviser disclosure flag on file.
disclosuresOnly.title: Disclosures only

enrichDetails.description: Fetch each record's full BrokerCheck profile (disclosures, exams, registrations, employment history). Adds one request per record.
enrichDetails.sectionDescription: Controls how much detail is added to every record.
enrichDetails.title: Fetch full profile details

firmName.description: Firm name (full or partial), CRD number or BrokerCheck firm URL (mode=firmSearch).
firmName.title: Firm name or CRD

firmNameOrCrd.description: Optional firm name or CRD. Constrains broker searches to people currently employed at that firm; leave `name` empty to scan the firm's representatives (modes=searchBrokers, searchByState, disclosureSearch).
firmNameOrCrd.title: Employer firm filter

includeDisclosures.description: Include individual disclosure events with dates, allegations and sanctions when full profile details are fetched.
includeDisclosures.title: Include disclosure events

includePrevious.description: Include previous employment history in broker search results and profile records.
includePrevious.title: Include previous employers

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to search or fetch on FINRA BrokerCheck.
enumTitles: Search brokers by name or CRD
Search firms by name or CRD
Browse brokers registered in a US state
Find brokers with disclosures on file
Broker profiles by CRD or profile URL
Firm profiles by CRD or profile URL
mode.title: Mode

name.description: Broker name (full or partial), CRD number or BrokerCheck individual URL. Used by searchBrokers, searchByState and disclosureSearch; also accepted as a firmSearch fallback.
name.title: Broker name or CRD

state.description: US state filter. Required for searchByState; optional for broker and firm searches. FINRA matches records with a registration or employment location in this state, so it can be broader than the current office state.
state.sectionDescription: Optional filters for broker and firm searches.
state.title: Registered state

status.description: Actively registered, previously registered, barred (brokers) or expelled (firms).
status.title: Registration status

title: FINRA BrokerCheck Broker & Firm Disclosure Lookup Input
